# Datasance PoT Documentation

Datasance PoT (Platform of Things) is an Enterprise Open Source Fog and Distributed Edge Computing Platform.
Securely deploy, manage, and scale containerized workloads across thousands of heterogeneous far-edge and IoT environments.


## Core Concepts
- **Edge Computing**: Distributed computing paradigm bringing computation and data storage closer to the sources of data.
- **EdgeOps**: DevOps for the Edge.
- **Microservices**: Deploy and manage container microservices at the edge.
- **potctl**: The command-line interface for managing Datasance PoT.

## API
Datasance PoT Controller provides a comprehensive REST API for controlling the platform.
OpenAPI Spec: https://docs.datasance.com/api/
